statement: Fast validation counts a total budget of 5 GCC and Clang command variants after union and target expansion. Selection, coverage, admission and combined command fingerprint checks precede the budget decision. Above budget, explicit deferred JSON evidence names the selected count, budget and deferral to full required builds; at or below budget every selected variant replays. Changed first-party sources are admitted by each compiler's configured dependency closure, including included sources without their own database entries; standalone sources without database entries and sources consumed only by absent targets refuse before replay even above budget. Local compile/tidy share this admission. Included-source reports name proven consumers' inputs, and unconfigured-source reports exclude those inputs. Refusals, missing consumers or cross-selected TU entries, input errors, publication failures and compile/tidy failures remain failures. Evidence is replaced atomically after the temporary file closes and uploaded on the native route. The 60 CPU-second compile and 90 CPU-second per tidy configuration estimates bound replay to about 7 minutes on two vCPUs; hosted duration qualification remains pending and the timeout stays 20 minutes. The pilot reflection executable remains in both databases without slangc and is excluded from the default build in that case. Shader generation and reflection-parity CTest registration remain gated on slangc, with tool-present behaviour unchanged. Offline contracts evaluate Windows, Apple and Linux link branches and exercise compile and both tidy plans; native database generation remains CI qualification.
